findings.summary: An old WorkflowObservationBinding can perform its first bind after A->None->same A and receive a new-incarnation token, allowing the old WorkflowRun exit to fence the new incarnation.
A retried old-incarnation on_exit public event lacks run_incarnation, so an identity-only UI consumer can mark the new same-identity incarnation exited.

closed: Already-issued old exit tokens and internal scheduler exit/UI state are correctly incarnation-isolated.
